committees.name: Health, Education, Labor, and Pensions Committee

dimensions.assessment: Affects importers, domestic and foreign food facilities seeking audits, and state, local, tribal, and territorial health authorities.
dimensions.evidence: eligible entity means a foreign or domestic entity, including a foreign or domestic facility subject to registration

dimensions.assessment: Significant for owners of refused imported food facing mandatory destruction at their own cost, and expands regulatory reach for food safety.
dimensions.evidence: owner or consignee shall be responsible for the costs of such destruction

dimensions.assessment: Imposes destruction costs directly on private owners or consignees rather than specifying direct federal outlays, aside from standard administrative duties.
dimensions.evidence: owner or consignee shall be responsible for the costs of such destruction

dimensions.assessment: Amends the Federal Food, Drug, and Cosmetic Act by granting new administrative powers regarding destruction, information sharing, and third-party certifications.
dimensions.evidence: To amend the Federal Food, Drug, and Cosmetic Act with respect to food safety.

dimensions.assessment: Establishes permanent statutory authorities for the FDA along with fixed rulemaking deadlines.
dimensions.evidence: Not later than 18 months after the date of enactment... issue proposed regulations

missing_information: Specific estimates of the volume or monetary value of foods subject to destruction are omitted.
importance_detail.rationale: Expands FDA authority to order the destruction of certain unsafe imported foods, share unredacted food safety information with lower-level government authorities, and extend third-party audit eligibility to domestic facilities.
